description: Calls off an escrow before payment. Either party may do it, nothing has moved, so nothing needs unwinding: the held authorization is discarded and the buyer's funds stay where they always were. Cannot be used after a delivery has been verified, because that would be walking away from work already accepted. Requires either party's token.

reason.description: Why it is being called off. Recorded on the escrow for both parties.

token.description: Your buyer_token or seller_token for this escrow.

name: escrow_cancel
